rulings.answer:
No. You perform ＜De-Digivolve  1＞ (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) twice, not ＜De-Digivolve  2＞ (Trash up to 2 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.). 
When performing ＜De-Digivolve  2＞ (Trash up to 2 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.), the top 2 cards are considered to be trashed at the same time, but when performing ＜De-Digivolve  1＞ (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) twice, the top 2 cards are trashed 1 at a time. 

For example, if using ＜De-Digivolve  2＞ (Trash up to 2 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) to simultaneously trash the top 2 cards of a suspended Digimon and the 2nd card trashed is BT15-047 [Kabuterimon], its effect won't activate. However, if performing ＜De-Digivolve  1＞ (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) twice and the Digimon becomes BT15-047 [Kabuterimon] after the 1st instance of ＜De-Digivolve  1＞ (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) trashes a card, it won't be affected by the 2nd instance of ＜De-Digivolve  1＞ (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) and won't be trashed.
